invitations_one_scope.name: invitations_one_scope
invitations_one_scope.value:
("invitations"."tenant_id" IS NOT NULL AND "invitations"."organization_id" IS NULL AND "invitations"."role" IN ('owner','editor','viewer','moderator'))
        OR ("invitations"."organization_id" IS NOT NULL AND "invitations"."tenant_id" IS NULL AND "invitations"."role" IN ('owner','billing'))

involvement_submissions_org_required.name: involvement_submissions_org_required
involvement_submissions_org_required.value: "involvement_submissions"."kind" = 'suggestion' OR ("involvement_submissions"."org_name" IS NOT NULL AND "involvement_submissions"."about" IS NOT NULL)

involvement_submissions_https_website.name: involvement_submissions_https_website
involvement_submissions_https_website.value: "involvement_submissions"."website" IS NULL OR "involvement_submissions"."website" LIKE 'https://%' OR "involvement_submissions"."website" LIKE 'http://%'
